backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing user authentication (credentials, phone/password verification), user profiles with medical data (blood type, allergies, emergency contacts), ML health predictions, and medical file storage with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining type aliases for all backend data structures (Credentials, UserProfile, MLPrediction, MedicalFileMetadata) and a pass-through migration function for canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: removal of checkup UI elements from Home.tsx and removal of checkup references from assistantBrain.ts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and Design B theme system with warm green palette and mobile-first navigation.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Deployment fix documentation explaining resolution of Node.js environment variable usage in browser code and duplicate provider wiring issues, with new frontendEnv.ts utility for Vite-compatible configuration.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for both default and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and Design B theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes (Welcome, SignIn, SignUp, Home, Profile, Chat, Report), wrapping with QueryClient, InternetIdentity, Theme, and DesignB providers in correct composition order.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: LocalStorage-based demo account management with phone number uniqueness enforcement, simple password hashing, account creation/verification functions, and support for backend credential sync.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for demo account management including DemoAccount, VerifyCredentialsResult, and CreateAccountResult with password hash support for backend synchronization.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Manages local authentication sessions in localStorage for OTP, password, and guest login types with 30-day expiration, validation, and session lifecycle functions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Command interpreter using fuzzy matching and pattern recognition to route user inputs to navigation, medical knowledge lookup, report analysis, or help responses with Flutter/.dart detection.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Main UI component for the health assistant featuring transcript display, voice input/output controls, text input, and formatted medical content rendering with confidence indicators.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence for assistant conversation transcripts with versioning (v2) and migration support, including confidence level tracking.
Core TypeScript type definitions for assistant messages, status states, command results, confidence levels, and report analysis context.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Orchestrates the assistant chatbot widget with Sheet UI, handling user commands, report analysis workflows, medical file integration, and text extraction from uploaded documents.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Custom: Empty file placeholder for custom question-answer management functionality.
frontend/src/components/assistant/custom: Empty file placeholder for custom QA storage functionality.
Empty file placeholder for custom QA type definitions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/fuzzyQ: Empty file placeholder for fuzzy question-answer matching logic.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Comprehensive medical knowledge base with curated content on blood pressure, diabetes, and other health topics including symptoms, precautions, emergency guidance, and keyword-based topic matching.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, interpretations, suggested actions, and red flags using regex patterns and keyword matching without AI/LLM.
Extracts plain text from file bytes for text-based formats (txt, csv, json, etc.) by decoding UTF-8 and validating the result is not binary data.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook managing assistant conversation transcript state with localStorage persistence, providing methods to add messages and clear history.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: React hook wrapping browser SpeechRecognition API with retry logic, error handling, confidence scoring, and support for both interim and final transcripts.
React hook for text-to-speech functionality using browser SpeechSynthesis API with enable/disable toggle and speaking state management.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: React hook providing auto-scroll behavior for transcript containers, detecting user scroll position and automatically scrolling to bottom when new messages arrive if user is near bottom.
frontend/src/components/CloseButton.tsx: Renders a fixed-position close button (X icon) that navigates to /home by default or executes a custom onClick handler.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: Reusable dashboard section header component displaying title, optional caption, and optional action element with consistent styling.
Interactive dashboard tile component with icon, label, value, and caption, supporting multiple color accents, sizes, variants, hover effects, and optional close button.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: Base surface container component for Design B theme with three variants (default, elevated, outlined) providing consistent card-like styling.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Typography components for Design B theme including PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, and BodyText with consistent text styling and sizing.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: Toggle switch component allowing users to switch between default theme and Design B theme using context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Defines UserProfile interface and generates a mock user profile with consistent data using a seeded random generator for demo purposes.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: Main app shell component for Design B theme with sticky header, logo, user display, theme switcher, outlet for child routes, bottom navigation tabs, assistant widget, and footer. Conditionally hides navigation on welcome/signin/signup routes.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: Fixed bottom navigation bar with three tabs (Home, Reports, Profile) that highlights the active route and handles navigation using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Utility functions to save and load theme preference ('default' or 'designB') from localStorage with error handling.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines Design B theme constants (colors, fonts, spacing, radius) and provides functions to apply or remove the theme by setting a data attribute on the document element.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: React context provider and hook for managing Design B theme state, persisting theme preference to localStorage, and applying theme attribute to document element.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Hook for managing local authentication session state with methods to sign in via OTP, password, guest mode, clear session, and check for valid session.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendCredentials: React Query hook for backend credential operations including checking if credentials exist, adding new credentials, and verifying credentials with phone number and hashed password.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Hook for demo OTP functionality that generates 6-digit codes, verifies them with expiry and cooldown logic, and manages OTP session state for phone-based authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY AuthClient, managing identity state, login/logout flow, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: React Query hook for managing medical file operations including listing files with metadata, uploading files as ExternalBlob, deleting files, and downloading/viewing files with byte retrieval.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for backend data fetching, including an example query structure and a hook to fetch the current user's profile via Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Hook that redirects authenticated users (via Internet Identity or local session) from public pages to /home.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin by checking both Internet Identity and local session state.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Hook that resolves user display name with priority: profile full name, session full name, session phone, guest label, or shortened principal.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind imports, custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, and Design B theme overrides using HSL color values.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using seeded PRNG to create realistic user profiles with names, emails, phones, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file placeholder for appointment details page.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Medical assistant chat page with text and voice input, transcript management, and command interpretation using assistantBrain.
frontend/src/pages/Chatbot.tsx: Empty file placeholder for chatbot page.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorList.tsx: Empty file placeholder for doctor list page.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Health dashboard page displaying today's health metrics (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and quick action tiles for navigation to various health tools.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Empty file placeholder for home dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/Locate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for locate page.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Component that redirects removed or not-found routes to /home using useEffect.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Profile management page that displays and allows editing of user personal and medical information (name, contact, blood type, allergies, emergency contact) with validation, and includes sign-out functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical reports page that allows users to upload, view, and delete medical documents with file size display and format validation.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page supporting three authentication methods: Internet Identity, OTP via phone, and password-based login, with guest access option.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Account creation page that collects user details (name, phone, password) and stores credentials both locally and in backend, then initializes profile and signs in.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing page with hero image, feature highlights, and call-to-action buttons for sign-in or guest exploration.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Utility module that maps between frontend ProfileDetails and backend UserProfile types, including blood type enum conversion and date/bigint timestamp transformations.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Manages localStorage persistence of user profile data keyed by session (phone number for password/OTP, stable guest ID for guest sessions). Provides functions to load, save, clear, and initialize profiles from auth-captured details.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the ProfileDetails interface (name, email, phone, DOB, blood type, allergies, emergency contact, location) and utility functions to create empty profiles and check if profile data exists.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates ProfileDetails fields (name required, email format, phone format, emergency contact completeness) and returns a ValidationResult with isValid flag and error messages.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React hook that fetches and saves profile details, handling both Internet Identity (backend actor) and local sessions (localStorage) with React Query for caching and mutations.
Manages localStorage persistence of medical file metadata keyed by file ID. Provides CRUD operations for metadata but is deprecated for listing purposes in favor of backend API.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Reads build-time environment configuration from Vite's import.meta.env, specifically the Internet Identity URL with fallback to production II URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (using OKLCH), fonts (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans), container settings, border radius variables, shadows, and keyframe animations for the UI.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating completed removal of checkup UI from Home dashboard and assistant brain, with pending tasks to remove checkup backend endpoints and remaining frontend routes/components.
